prompt: A striking female clown cyborg with an elegant yet unsettling presence, standing center frame in a dim futuristic carnival. Porcelain-white synthetic skin is cracked in places, revealing polished chrome machinery, exposed micro-cables, hydraulic joints, and faintly glowing circuitry beneath. Her clown makeup is graphic and asymmetrical: smeared crimson lips, sharp black eye shapes, tiny painted tears, and faded blush. One eye is human, the other a luminous mechanical lens. She wears a distressed retro clown costume fused with cybernetic armor, oversized ruffled collar, metallic corset, striped fabric, and mechanical prosthetic limbs. Cold cyan neon mixes with dirty red carnival lights, reflecting across wet pavement. Cinematic portrait composition, shallow depth of field, eerie fog, gritty textures, beautiful but menacing, retro-futurist body-horror atmosphere, highly realistic materials and dramatic chiaroscuro lighting.
